messages:
ava: quick q — opened a docs PR to combine the 429 + timeout troubleshooting material into a single client-errors guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4823. can ppl skim for SDK snippet mismatches and link breakage?

sam: saw it briefly. Node and Python retry examples are inconsistent — node uses Retry-After parsing, python just sleeps a fixed time. i'll normalize.

jordan: +1 to standardizing. propose we show exponential backoff + full jitter and a small code example for both SDKs. e.g. for node: ```js
function backoff(attempt){
  const base = 200; // ms
  const max = 20000;
  const sleep = Math.min(max, Math.floor(base * Math.pow(2, attempt)));
  return Math.random() * sleep; // jitter
}
```
keep it short in the docs and link to a helper util.

marco: also remember we need to call out context-limit failures separately from rate limits. wording in the current draft implies both return 429 which is confusing. can we clarify the HTTP mapping we use and the preferred fallback order? e.g. on context-limit exceed -> prompt trim suggestions -> on 429 -> respect Retry-After header -> exponential backoff -> fallback model.

elaine: i can do the link sweep and crossrefs. quick question: what should be the canonical slug? `troubleshooting/client-errors` or `error-reference/client-errors`? i prefer the former for discoverability.

ava: leaning `troubleshooting/client-errors` as well. i'll rename the PR and collapse the two pages into one sectioned guide if everyone agrees. @sam can you update the Node snippet, @jordan can you add the python jitter example? @marco @elaine can you review links + policy language? :question:

sam: on it. i'll also add a small SDK callout showing how to surface `Retry-After` and a header we use in the platform `x-rw-retry-count` for diagnostics. example: `headers['x-rw-retry-count'] = attempt`.

docs-bot: checklist: [x] lint pass, [ ] linkcheck, [ ] samples lint, reviewers requested: @marco @elaine. please add reviewer tags once assigned.

marco: i can review tomorrow AM :eyes: please flag any high-risk wording around SLA behaviors.

jordan: one tiny nit — for the rate-limit section we should explicitly show reading Retry-After and falling back to backoff. snippet suggestion: ```js
const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
if(ra>0) await sleep(ra*1000); else await sleep(backoff(attempt));
```
that prevents hammering when a header is present.

elaine: i'll add a short telemetry note in the guide: what events to watch (`error.type=rate_limit`, `error.type=context_limit`, `metric.request.latency`) and a link to the observability dashboard. also will fix a broken anchor in the rollout docs linking to the fallback-policy section.

ava: perfect, thanks. i'll merge after you two review and then open a follow-up for adding CI snippet smoke tests. tagging this thread for visibility to the docs squad. :shipit:

sam: thanks all, will push the node changes in a follow-up commit.

marco: good plan.

jordan: done with my snippet patch, pushed to the PR.

elaine: link fixes pushed.

ava: merging in ~1h if no objections. follow-up: add a short example for SDKs showing automatic fallback to smaller model when context trim fails.

sam: noted, will help with the SDK examples after merge.

docs-bot: PR #4823 status changed: reviewers approved -> ready to merge.
